description: This file defines the AppTheme class which provides static methods to generate light and dark ThemeData objects for theming a Flutter application. It sets color schemes, text styles, and theme configurations.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static getters for theme data used across the app, both light and dark themes.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns ThemeData configured for light mode, including color scheme, app bar theme, text styles, and density settings.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Returns ThemeData configured for dark mode, with suitable color scheme, app bar, text styles, and density.
